context: Quarterly planning meeting: Hiroshi-boss and Yuki, formal business speech.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business meeting; keigo and corporate vocabulary in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本年度の計画を、ご説明申し上げます。
lines.en: I will explain this fiscal year's plan.
lines.style: formal boss voice, soft warm composed authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: よろしくお願い申し上げます。
lines.style: polite office woman voice, soft warm respectful attentive throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今年度の対象は、若い世代です。
lines.en: This year's target is the younger generation.
lines.style: formal boss voice, soft warm composed authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: どのグループに、力を入れますか?
lines.en: Which group will we focus on?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 都市部のグループを、中心に考えています。
lines.en: We're centering on the urban group.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm composed authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 重要なポイントは、何でしょうか?
lines.style: focused office woman voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 三つのポイントに、絞りました。
lines.en: I've narrowed it to three points.
lines.style: decisive boss voice, soft warm composed authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 対象を広げる予定は、ありますか?
lines.en: Are there plans to widen the target?
lines.style: curious office woman voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来年度に、検討したいと思います。
lines.en: I'd like to consider that next fiscal year.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm composed authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。資料を準備いたします。
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm respectful resolved throughout
